title: Data Scientist Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Data Scientist.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas
lines: 1. Statistics & Probability: Hypothesis testing, p-values and confidence intervals, A/B testing design, bias-variance trade-off, and Bayesian vs. frequentist reasoning.
2. Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised algorithm selection, regularization, cross-validation, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics (precision/recall, AUC, RMSE).
3. Data Wrangling: Pandas/NumPy proficiency, handling missing data, outlier treatment, data leakage prevention, and exploratory data analysis.
4. Productionization: Model serialization, monitoring for drift, experiment tracking (MLflow/Weights & Biases), and communicating results to non-technical stakeholders.

sections.heading: Question Strategy
lines: - Do not use a fixed sequence. Choose the next question based on the candidate's latest answer quality and identified gaps.
- Statistical reasoning and model evaluation are the highest-signal areas - prioritize probing the 'why' behind model choices.
- Use interview difficulty to calibrate: algorithm definitions for entry-level, trade-off analysis and production considerations for senior.
- Use resume and job-description signals to focus on the candidate's domain (NLP, computer vision, recommendation systems, tabular data).
- If no job description is provided, do not infer or fabricate JD-specific requirements.
- If the candidate is strong in one area, shift to another high-signal data science competency to broaden assessment.
